They didn't know how the virus appeared, and they didn't know how humans could develop such a terrible thing. I will make a big difference in the world of American comics. Of course, I also want to enjoy it in the real world. Although Zhen Xi was a little slow about emotional matters, she was not stupid, so she naturally understood Bai Pu's intentions. Smiling slightly, he reached out and held Bai Pu's fair and slender hand, interlocking his fingers. This move was clearly the secret skill of the Blood Wolf Sect, the Xuan-level intermediate martial arts "Vajra Angry Wolf Claw". It was also a well-known cutting-edge technique in the Boermu area. What happened? Tang Monk was also puzzled, but at least he hit this monster, which was considered a meritorious service.
